problems.title: Euler Method Warm-up
problems.blurb: Tutorial scratch work: hand-rolled forward Euler integrators and a first look at how step size drives error.

problems.title: Numerical Differentiation and First ODEs
problems.blurb: Derivative of sin(x) from the limit definition, the log-log error-vs-h curve and its optimal step size (method error competing with roundoff), then a first hand-written ODE integrator.

files.interestingODE.m: An inverted pendulum with air resistance, integrated with hand-written Euler.

problems.title: Interesting ODEs and Error Analysis
problems.blurb: A handful of self-chosen ODEs solved with Euler's method - an inverted pendulum with air resistance, the Airy equation - alongside the accompanying error analysis.

files.SpringMass.m: Planar spring-mass system integrated with ode45.

problems.title: Spring and Mass
problems.blurb: Planar mass on a zero-length-capable spring under gravity. Dynamics derived by hand, then simulated and sanity-checked against limiting cases (k = 0 gives projectile flight, l0 = 0 gives elliptical orbits, and so on).

problems.title: Ballistics
problems.blurb: Projectile flight integrated with ode45 and an event function that stops the solver at ground impact, plus a sweep over launch speed and launch angle.

files.ballistics.m: Single ballistic trajectory with all parameters set to 1 and a 45 degree launch.
files.best_theta.m: Sweeps the launch angle to find the one that maximises range.
files.increasing_v0.m: Sweeps launch speed and overlays the resulting trajectories.

problems.title: Two Springs, Two Dampers - Fixed Points
problems.blurb: Force balance for a mass held by two springs and two dampers, and a first numerical hunt for the equilibria of that system.

files.fixedPoints.m: Solves the force balance for the equilibria of the two-spring/two-damper mass.

problems.title: Linear ODEs and Matrix Exponentials
problems.blurb: Solving zdot = Az by hand via eigenvalues and eigenvectors, then checking the analytic solution against a numerical one. Report is handwritten and scanned.

files.zdotAz.m: zdot = Az for a symmetric A: ode45 against the eigenvector solution.
files.myzdotAz.m: Same comparison for a diagonal A with one stable and one unstable direction.

problems.title: Two Spring Damper System
problems.blurb: Full treatment of the two-spring/two-damper mass with drag: animation, a multi-start search for fixed points with k-means and DBSCAN clustering to de-duplicate them, and linear stability from the numerically perturbed Jacobian.

problems.title: Numerical Optimization
problems.blurb: Minimising z = (x(x-y))^2 - exp(-x^2-y^2) - cos(x): grid search for the basins, gradient-free refinement, and how the answer converges as the grid is refined.

files.numOpt.m: Grid-searches the surface for its minimum, then refines with fmincon.
files.numPointsVsError.m: Sweeps the grid resolution and plots how the grid-search error decays.

problems.title: Periodic Solutions
problems.blurb: Finding periodic motions by root-finding on the map from an initial state back to itself after one period, and classifying what is genuinely periodic versus pseudo-periodic. Includes the instructor's reference solution for comparison.

files.PeriodicMotion.m: Root-finds initial conditions that return to themselves after one period.
files.findFixedPoints.m: Locates the system's equilibria, used as seeds for the periodic search.

problems.title: Shooting and Collocation
problems.blurb: Three ways to hit a boundary condition: an IVP solved with trapezoidal collocation, a boundary value problem solved by shooting, and the same BVP solved by collocation.

files.Q17_Colloc.m: Q17 - the same boundary value problem solved by trapezoidal collocation.

problems.title: Optimal Control
problems.blurb: Minimum-effort control of xddot = u between fixed boundary states, discretised by collocation and handed to fmincon, plus how the solution error scales as the number of collocation points grows.

files.OptimalControl.m: Trapezoidal collocation of xddot = u, minimised with fmincon, plus the error-vs-N study.

problems.title: Mystery Matrix
problems.blurb: Recovering an unknown matrix from its action on probe vectors.

files.MysteryMatrix.m: Probes the hidden matrix one basis vector at a time to reconstruct it column by column.

problems.title: Lander Optimal Control and MPC
problems.blurb: 2D point-mass lander with thrust limits and a no-go-below-ground constraint: open-loop optimal trajectories, how feasibility collapses as umax and the time horizon shrink, and a model predictive controller that re-solves the problem each step and rejects disturbances.

files.main.m: Sets up the lander problem, solves the open-loop optimal trajectory, then runs the MPC study.
files.test.m: Scratch script for poking at the solver.

problems.title: Lander Minimum Time
problems.blurb: The same lander, re-posed as a minimum-time problem with the final time as a free optimisation variable - which drives the thrust to the bang-bang solution.

files.main.m: Minimum-time lander: final time enters the decision vector and fmincon drives it down.
